Hero_Desc_RohneMayor:
Under orders from the Intelligence Chief, Rohne somehow became the mayor of Monatium.
Her unexpected talent transforms Monatium into a better place to live and earns the enthusiastic support of its citizens.
She is currently managing, one way or another, to restrain her occasional rampaging desire for pork cutlets.
Album_Hate_RohneMayor: Food pretending to be pork cutlet, and whoever insists on making it
Album_RohneMayor1: Rohne succeeded Elena after she stepped down as mayor. What will become of Monatium now? Perhaps not all of Elias, but I, at least, am a little worried.
Album_RohneMayor2: After defeating a field of formidable opponents and somehow becoming mayor, Rohne is surprisingly passionate about her work. Though somewhat inarticulate and clumsy, she seems to be building an image as an adorable mayor and winning the support of Monatium's citizens.
Album_RohneMayor3: Rohne sometimes complains that she wishes the City Hall cafeteria served pork cutlet every day. Knowing that this is realistically impossible appears to cause her considerable distress.
Album_RohneMayor4: Unlike the awkward behavior she displayed as a spy, Rohne carries out her duties as mayor with remarkable confidence and competence. This unexpected side of her leaves me, Elena, and Amelia equally bewildered.
Album_RohneMayor5: As time passes, the many organizations and institutions supporting Monatium are beginning to recognize Rohne's position. Some Sprites have apparently heard about her policies and are even considering moving to Monatium.
Album_RohneMayor6: Rohne once visited the banquet hall frequently, but her work has made those visits increasingly rare. I miss her a little, yet thinking of how diligently she is working fills part of my heart with pride. I should call her separately and ask how she has been.
Album_RohneMayor7: Elena and Amelia have begun bringing Rohne with them whenever they have something to discuss. Has she now been fully recognized as a senior official of Monatium City Hall? It is a deeply satisfying sight. Though... Elena has also begun occasionally leaving every task to Rohne, sending her alone while she shirks her own work.
LoveHero_RohneMayor: I-It is an honor to establish such a close alliance with the Order!
LoveHeroCancel_RohneMayor: I-Is this a declaration of war? Aaaah~! How am I supposed to respond to this situation?!
Food_ChefNote_RohneMayor_Hate1: Rohne had been thrilled that she would finally get to eat pork cutlet, but flew into a rage, lost control, and crashed into Amelia as she passed by. We had to watch Rohne's apology performance for an entire month.
Food_ChefNote_RohneMayor_Hate2: She shook her head, saying that although it was certainly efficient food, she still could not adjust to the cold taste of reality contained in space rations.
Food_ChefNote_RohneMayor_Like1: Rohne delivered an impressive line about Monatium's future shining like this Golden Tanghulu. When I applauded, she smiled bashfully.
Food_ChefNote_RohneMayor_Like2: Rohne smiled brightly, saying it let her finish a busy, exhausting day on a sweet and refreshing note.
Food_ChefNote_RohneMayor_Like3: She muttered that she could eat only after finishing the work of tying ribbons around gift boxes, then resolutely began spooning up her rice cake soup.
Food_ChefNote_RohneMayor_Like4: While eating happily, Rohne suddenly asked for the buche de Noel recipe and wrote it down. Something about giving it to the personal chef employed at City Hall.
Food_ChefNote_RohneMayor_Like5: She tasted the powder with the sternest expression she could manage, then exclaimed that it was far too tart and made a fuss like the Rohne we all know.
Food_ChefNote_RohneMayor_Like6: She suspected that the songpyeon might be empty inside like an Air Cutlet, but one bite brought a deeply satisfied expression to her face.
Food_ChefNote_RohneMayor_Like7: Saying its soft sweetness kept drawing her hand back, she packed Almond Rochers to eat as snacks while working.
Food_ChefNote_RohneMayor_Like8: She has been so busy rushing through her schedule that she cannot eat proper meals, and was delighted that this would make a convenient substitute.
Food_ChefNote_RohneMayor_Like9: She praised me for constantly researching and presenting foods that Apostles would enjoy, such as Ball Candy. But I did not make this...

LoveLetter_RohneMayor:
Hello, Master! This is Rohne, former mayor and current Intelligence Chief. It feels like only yesterday that I ran around calling myself a master spy, yet somehow I have already become the Intelligence Chief. It was all possible because you trusted and encouraged me!

I am sending a small gift with all my gratitude. Please accept it as a gift between allies! From now on, as Intelligence Chief, I will carefully monitor developments in the Sprite Kingdom while doing my utmost to protect the Order's safety and peace.
LoveCall_RohneMayor:
Have you been well, Master?
If you have been living peacefully, that must mean I am properly fulfilling my role as Intelligence Chief, right? Hehe.
Ah, it is currently working hours... but checking on your well-being is one of my important daily duties too!

Ah, which reminds me, Master. I wanted to have a pork cutlet date with you... N-No!
I want to hold a secret strategy meeting!
The Banquet Hall is nice, but since this is a strategy meeting, today is my treat!
It does not have to be pork cutlet! Choose anything you like, Master.
Accommodating the other person's tastes! I heard that is the first step toward a successful operation.

Apparently, many good restaurants have opened in the Sprite Kingdom lately... Where should we go?
Since this is a strategy meeting for only the two of us, you must keep it secret when you come, understood?
I will see you later! Hehet!
